title: Men in Black on Ashaway Road

tellings.quote: It was in it was in um Rhode Island. Uh I lived there in this would have been 1990 when this was happening right around the time of the first Gulf War

plain: In 1990, around the time of the first Gulf War, the author Peter Levenda says he had an encounter with Men in Black, the dark-suited strangers said to appear around people connected to UFO matters, on Ashaway Road in Rhode Island, where he was living. Levenda tells it himself as something that happened to him, and in the same telling he brings up the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun. For Levenda it is a sign that someone was watching him.
